BANFF · JASPER · VANCOUVER

Glacial lakes, the Icefields Parkway and a Pacific finish.

Seven nights from Calgary to Vancouver: Banff, Jasper, then a long daylight drive to the coast. Wildfire smoke is the main risk, so keep the Moraine and Yoho days swappable.

Book and check, in order

  1. Apr 15, 2027Moraine Alpine Start shuttle: 40% of seats release 08:00 MDT (2026 pattern). Try this first.
  2. NowBeds first, refundable. Jasper before anything else; late July is peak everywhere.
  3. Sat Jul 24Moraine backup: the other 60% release 08:00 MDT two days before, Seattle 07:00.
  4. Sun Jul 25Tuesday backup Moraine seats: 48 hour release Sunday 07:00 Seattle time, before your flight.
  5. Before the tripSpirit Island cruise, roughly C$80 to 100. Columbia Icefield Ice Explorer, about C$126+, sells out.
  6. Before the tripVancouver stay with parking for Friday night, or C$30 to 50 for a lot. BC Day weekend.
  7. Before the tripApply for an eTA on canada.ca. Put your flight number on the Avis booking.

Day by day

Sun 25 JulArrivalTravelScenic1h30 driving
Land 18:10, car by 19:00, Banff by about 20:45.
  • Avis counter in the rental area across from baggage claim, open 07:00 to 01:00.
  • Buy Parks Canada admission online before the park gate on Highway 1.
  • Vermilion Lakes at sunset, about 21:35, five minutes from town: Mount Rundle in the water.
  • Late dinner on Banff Avenue; some kitchens close by 22:00. Alarm for 03:30.
Mon 26 JulNatureScenic45 min driving
Moraine Lake at sunrise, then Lake Louise.
  • Leave Banff 04:05 and park at the Lake Louise Lakeshore lot; the day fee was C$36.75 in 2026.
  • 05:00 Alpine Start shuttle BOOK AHEAD to Moraine, sunrise about 05:50; C$12.75 plus C$3.50 fee.
  • Moraine Lake MUST-SEE: Rockpile stairs first, 12 minutes, then the shoreline. Lake Connector back from 07:00.
  • 09:00 Lake Agnes Tea House, 7.9 km return, about 3 hours. Be down before afternoon thunderstorms.
Tue 27 JulNatureScenic
Yoho and Johnston Canyon; backup day for Moraine.
  • If Monday was smoky or clouded out, swap: Yoho Monday, Moraine today.
  • Emerald Lake MUST-SEE, about 1 hour west. Arrive before 10:00 for parking; 5.3 km flat loop.
  • Takakkaw Falls: 30 minute side road with tight switchbacks, then a short flat walk.
  • Johnston Canyon late afternoon, when parking frees up: Lower Falls through the cave, Upper Falls 30 m.

Where to stay

Jul 25 to 27, Sun to Tue · 3 nights
Banff town

Walkable Banff Avenue dinners, and 45 minutes to Lake Louise Lakeshore for Monday’s 04:05 start.

BOOK THIS Moraine Lake Lodge, Sunday night: Splurge: wake at Moraine with road access and skip the Alpine Start. About 2 hours from Calgary airport.

Budget: Canmore, 20 minutes east, is noticeably cheaper, but Monday’s alarm moves to about 03:45.

Know before you go

  • Late July is the priciest Rockies week: roughly C$400 to 700+ a night in Banff. Book refundable.
  • Carry bear spray on every trail. It cannot fly, so buy it in Banff.
  • Flying in needs an eTA. Apply only on canada.ca; lookalike sites charge a markup.

Festivals & Events

  • LIKELYBanff Gondola Sunset Festival: live music at the summit nightly, 18:00 to 21:30 in summer 2026. Ticket covers it.
  • LIKELYBanff Centre Summer Arts Festival: free AMP Sessions ran Jul 23 to 26 in 2026. Check the 2027 listing.
  • AT RISKMissed: Canmore Folk Music Festival, Jul 31 to Aug 2, and the Wednesday Banff Farmers’ Market, after you leave.

Day by day

Wed 28 JulScenicNatureTravel3h30 driving
Icefields Parkway: 230 km, and the drive is the day.
  • Leave Banff by 08:00. About 3.5 hours of driving from Lake Louise; arrive 18:00 to 19:00.
  • Peyto Lake MUST-SEE before 10:00; by midday the platform is shoulder to shoulder.
  • Fuel at Saskatchewan River Crossing, the only fuel. Almost no cell signal, so download offline maps.
  • Parker Ridge MUST-SEE: 6.8 km, 2.5 hours. Then Columbia Icefield, and Athabasca Falls just before Jasper.
Thu 29 JulNatureScenic
Maligne Lake and Spirit Island, then wildlife at dusk.
  • Maligne Lake cruise to Spirit Island MUST-SEEBOOK AHEAD: departures from 09:00, roughly C$80 to 100.
  • Maligne Canyon was closed all of 2026 for fire rehabilitation. Check its 2027 status.
  • Afternoon: Valley of the Five Lakes, reopened May 23, 2026, with better mountain views than before the fire.
  • Pyramid Lake in the evening. Drive slowly at dusk: elk and bears. Early night.
Fri 30 JulTravelScenic8h45 driving
Pyramid Lake at dawn, then the long daylight drive.
  • Leave Jasper 09:00 MT: 790 km, 8.5 to 9 hours; clocks go back an hour.
  • Mount Robson from the visitor centre; the Overlander Falls path adds about 45 minutes.
  • Lunch in Clearwater about 12:30; Kamloops 14:30, Hope 16:30, Airbnb 18:30 to 19:30.
  • Check DriveBC at breakfast. Never drive after dark: moose, elk and deer on Highways 16 and 5.

Where to stay

Jul 28 and 29, Wed and Thu · 2 nights
Jasper town

Restaurants in town, Maligne Lake an hour away, and Pyramid Lake ten minutes off for Friday’s dawn.

BOOK THIS Fairmont Jasper Park Lodge: Splurge: lakeside cabins, fully operational.

Book first: The 2024 fire took out about 20% of hotel beds. Book Jasper before anything else.

Know before you go

  • Closed for 2026: Maligne Canyon and Cavell Road. Maligne Lake, the SkyTram, Icefield and Parkway are open.
  • Parkway: one fuel stop, almost no cell signal. Never stop in a live lane for bears.

Festivals & Events

  • UNCERTAINNothing major on these dates. Jasper’s Dark Sky Festival is in October.
  • HIGH CONFIDENCEAlberta Heritage Day and BC Day are both Mon Aug 2, 2027. You leave before the long weekend traffic.

Day by day

Sat 31 JulFestivalCulture
Two fixed points: the car and the festival.
  • Return the car to Avis, 757 Hornby St, by 17:00; aim for 16:30. No after hours returns.
  • Powell Street Festival MUST-SEE, 11:30 to 19:00, about 10 minutes by taxi from Hornby.
  • Do car places first: Queen Elizabeth Park, Kits, Spanish Banks, Prospect Point, Deep Cove.
  • Use the Ironworkers (Second Narrows) bridge in the afternoon; Lions Gate backs up.
Sun 1 AugTravelCulture
A walking morning, then the 16:45 flight.
  • Seawall by bike and Granville Island by Aquabus; Powell Street runs again from 11:30.
  • 13:15 Canada Line from Vancouver City Centre to YVR, about 25 minutes; at the airport by 14:15.
  • NH115 YVR 16:45, lands Haneda 19:00 next day. The Pride Parade, about 13:00, is missed.

Where to stay

Jul 30 and 31, Fri and Sat · 2 nights
Downtown, around Hornby & Georgia

Avis at 757 Hornby, the Canada Line station and Powell Street by taxi are all close.

Parking: Book a stay with parking for Friday night, or budget C$30 to 50 for a nearby lot.

Know before you go

  • Use Saturday’s car for spread out spots; keep Sunday for what you can walk or reach by Aquabus.
  • Powell Street gets its last two hours on Saturday, because the car goes back by 17:00.

Festivals & Events

  • HIGH CONFIDENCEPowell Street Festival, Jul 31 to Aug 1, 2027: every BC Day long weekend since 1977, 11:30 to 19:00.
  • AT RISKVancouver Pride Parade is Sun Aug 1, about 13:00, while you are on the train. Missed.
  • UNCERTAINHonda Celebration of Light was cancelled in Nov 2025; 2026 had a one night show on BC Day Friday.
